channel.title: on Industrial Manufacturing Knowledge Base
channel.description: Open industrial manufacturing knowledge base: aluminum & magnesium die casting, CNC machining, injection molding, tooling, materials, automotive manufacturing and supplier selection. 50+ engineering articles and reference tables.

item.title: Building an RFQ Package for Castings and Machined Parts
item.description: What to include in a casting and machining RFQ: 3D models, GD&T prints, CTQ list, volume ramp, PPAP level, and how suppliers build and compare quotes.

item.title: How to Choose a Die Casting Supplier: Evaluation Guide
item.description: A structured supplier evaluation guide for die casting: machine tonnage, alloy coverage, secondary ops, quality certs, engineering support and red flags.

item.title: Inspection and Acceptance Criteria for Production Parts
item.description: Define acceptance for production parts: AQL sampling, CMM and FAIR dimensional checks, CTQ control, nonconformance handling, leak and X-ray testing, and traceability.

item.title: Manufacturing Supplier Audit Checklist for Buyers: QSA and QPA
item.description: A buyer's on-site supplier audit checklist covering QSA system review, QPA process audit, calibration, traceability, FMEA, control plan and corrective action maturity.

item.title: Tooling Ownership, IP and Supply Agreements: Buyer's Guide
item.description: How die and mold ownership, IP rights, NDAs, exclusivity, dual sourcing and transfer rights work in supply agreements, plus vesting and contractual exit.
